body.name: Dropout subdensities
body.construction: For \(d<T\), \(g_d(w,a,x_{1:T})=p_W(w)p_A(a\mid w)K_1(x_1\mid w,a)\prod_{t=2}^T K_t(x_t\mid w,a,x_{t-1})\{\prod_{s=1}^{d}q_s(w,a,x_{S_s})\}\{1-q_{d+1}(w,a,x_{S_{d+1}})\}\); for \(d=T\), omit the final failure factor and retain \(\prod_{s=1}^{T}q_s(w,a,x_{S_s})\).
